summary_en: The study tests AT-1965 liposome injection in adults with advanced, refractory or recurrent solid tumors, including metastatic triple-negative breast cancer. AT-1965 is given into a vein once a week on days 1, 8 and 15 of each 4-week cycle, and the total length of treatment is not stated. The Phase 1/2 study measures the maximum tolerated dose or recommended Phase 2 dose and dose-limiting toxicities, along with safety and early signs of antitumor activity.
summary_es: El estudio evalúa el liposoma inyectable AT-1965 en adultos con tumores sólidos avanzados, refractarios o recurrentes, incluido el cáncer de mama triple negativo metastásico. AT-1965 se administra por vena una vez por semana los días 1, 8 y 15 de cada ciclo de 4 semanas, y la duración total del tratamiento no se indica. Es un estudio de fase 1/2 que mide la dosis máxima tolerada o la dosis recomendada para fase 2, las toxicidades limitantes de dosis, la seguridad y las primeras señales de actividad antitumoral.
who_for: Unresectable or metastatic solid tumor that is refractory to standard therapy, or for which no standard therapy is suitable in the investigator's opinion.
At least one measurable lesion per RECIST version 1.1; Part A may allow non-measurable disease after sponsor discussion.
Age 18 or older with ECOG performance status 0 to 2.
Adequate blood counts, kidney function and liver function, as defined in the criteria.

not_for: Uncontrolled or unstable serious medical conditions, or uncontrolled diabetes.
History of interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis, or active pneumonitis within the last 6 months.
Clinically significant heart disease, including recent heart attack or stroke, LVEF below 50%, or QTcF of 470 msec or higher.
Anticancer therapy within 21 days, radiation within 2 weeks, or major surgery within 4 weeks.
Known HIV, unresolved hepatitis B or C, history of hemolysis, or adrenal gland disorders.
